name: Cut Capsule
language: the source video's language (captions in it)
format: Entertainment clip page: the best 20-59 s moments from long videos (podcasts, streams, interviews, GTA 6 streams), cut to start on the hook and end on the payoff; blurred fill, the video full width, hook title on top, word-by-word captions

rules: never a GTA 6 story spoiler: no ending, no cutscene compilations, no big plot reveals (Rockstar removes them)
no hate, no harassment, no sexual content, no real-life violence
the clip must make sense to someone who never saw the video
